headlines.title: What Is Netflix (NFLX) Signaling With Its New Content Acquisition Chief?
headlines.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) has appointed Craig Ferguson as director of content acquisition, effective early October 2026. Ferguson brings experience from senior content roles across major Hollywood studios, large tech platforms and digital distributors. His background includes leading content licensing and development teams focused on streaming, digital rights and multi platform distribution deals.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
